items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Miss Cole, her name was Miss Cole, and she had that big place on the corner of Willow

ctx.x: And she was the woman that they say used to insure so many people, and then they caught on to her, and they would die right now. She had that lawn place up there. It was on Willow, wasn't it? Yeah, I think it was somewhere back there. How do you call them? Miss Cole, her name was Miss Cole, and she had that big place on the corner of Willow and some of them street back Magnolia or something. I don't know the streets much, you know. I know how to get to them, but I hardly ever keep them in mind, too.
Kid Bunch tells me about that.
